about: Catalog for the APPS workspace (Zzz5-W9). Versions, sizes and SHA-256 come from each item's own manifest, never from this file. An item without a manifest that carries sha256 is listed but never offered for download. Kind 'gated' = file only for logged-in Verso users through edge function verso-apps; version and SHA-256 come from table verso_app_releases.

apps.name: Verso app (Android)
apps.info: Verso as an Android app. Carries Verso Keyboard and Verso Voice Reader inside.

apps.name: Verso Keyboard + Passboard
apps.info: Android keyboard - works in other apps too. In password fields it switches to PASSBOARD by itself (one keyboard, not two). Turn it on once in Android keyboard settings.

apps.name: Verso Keyboard (standalone app)
apps.info: The same Verso Keyboard + Passboard as its own small app, for phones without the Verso app.

apps.name: Verso Voice Reader
apps.info: Reads text aloud, offline. Never reads codes, passwords or PINs.

apps.name: Slovak voice (lili)
apps.info: Voice for Verso Voice Reader. Downloaded and checked inside the Reader.
